title: 第11章 请赐教第12章 一拳秒
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: “哈哈哈，林少，这种垃圾废物，您又何必在意呢？他就算是在杨家报了名，那也不过是充个数罢了。”
“是啊林少，一个连灵石都交不起的废物，又能有什么实力？就他还想加入神炎宗，这不是搞笑吗？”
青年身后，那两名男子也都跟着起哄了起来。
他们满脸高傲看着李轩，一副蔑视的神情。
李轩看着三人，眼神忍不住眯起。
哪来的野狗，怎么如此讨厌？
杨愈也是气的有些面色涨红，她冷冷盯着那为首青年，“林川，你不要太过分。我杨家怎么选人，还轮不到你来管。”
她是真的气，如果不是四大家族联手针对杨家，杨家至于沦落至此吗？
每次的神炎宗弟子选拔，那些在杨家通过筛选的人，下场都极惨，很少有能够全身而退的。
若非如此，也不会没人敢来杨家报名。
杨家也有想过不再参与神炎宗弟子选拔的事情，可却又不甘心放弃。
没办法，这些年来，杨家资源本就被侵吞的没有了多少，若是连神炎宗弟子选拔都不参与，那就真的要除名了。
要知道，每次的神炎宗弟子选拔，五大家族都是能够得到好处的。
通过的人越多，表现的越出众，得到的好处也就会越大。
杨愈尽管愤怒，却是并没有纠缠。
“我们走。”
她冷冷的留下一句话，拉着李轩就想要离开。
没办法，实力不如人，只能忍。
这些年来，类似这样的羞辱，她已经不是第一次承受了。
然而，杨愈却是没能拉动李轩。
她抬头疑惑的看向李轩，心中忍不住轻叹。
难道，李轩不敢去杨家报名了？
这倒是也可以理解。
毕竟，这种事情也已经不是第一次发生，她都习惯了。
然而，就在她带着失落，打算自己独自离去的时候，李轩忽然问道，“杨小姐，请问这里能动手吗？”
此言一出，不仅是杨愈愣住了，哪怕林川三人，都愣住了。
他们全都不可思议的看向李轩，就好像是听到了什么天大的笑话一般。
回过神后，杨愈大惊，赶忙说道，“公子，你可千万不要乱来。那个林川虽然嘴巴贱了点，可实力却是不弱。”
“他修为已经达到先天境一重，哪怕在林家都能够排入前五。这次更是必能加入神炎宗，你打不过的。”
杨愈拉李轩报名，可不是看中了李轩的天赋和实力。
开玩笑，李轩又没动手，她怎么可能会知道李轩的天赋和实力？
她只是刚好看到李轩在林家碰壁，这才过去拉人罢了。
事实上，她也只是有个念想而已，对李轩能够通过神炎宗弟子选拔，并没有抱太大希望。
“哟呵，你这是不服气，想要切磋切磋了？”
就在这时，林川的声音传来。
他看着李轩，那是一脸的不屑，“小子，看来你是没有出过门，没被毒打过啊。”
他又看向杨愈，咧嘴道：“你放心，对付这种货色，我林川还不屑动手，他也不配，我身后这二人足矣。”
李轩没有理会林川，他只是看着杨愈，“这里能不能动手，如果我打了他，会如何？”
林川这样的货色，李轩根本就没放在心上。
跳梁小丑而已。
他真正在意的是林川背后的林家。
毕竟，他现在没有靠山，如果打了小的，老的跑出来，那就麻烦了。
杨愈看到李轩如此坚定，低声道：“只要双方愿意，自然是能动手的，他败了那是他实力不如人，林家也没办法说什么。”
她显然也明白李轩的担忧，给李轩吃了一个定心丸，“你放心，我杨家虽然势微，但保住你还是没有问题的。林家想要以大欺小，绝无可能。”
李轩放心了。
content_en:
"Hahaha, Mr. Lin, why do you care about this kind of rubbish? Even if he signed up for the Yang family, it was just a fill-in."
"That's right, Mr. Lin. How can a loser who can't even afford spiritual stones have any strength? He still wants to join the Shenyan Sect. Isn't it funny?"
Behind the young man, the two men also started to boo.
They looked at Li Xuan with pride and contempt.
Li Xuan looked at the three of them and couldn't help but narrow his eyes.
Where did the wild dogs come from, and why are they so annoying?
Yang Yu's face turned red with anger. She stared coldly at the leading young man and said, "Lin Chuan, don't go too far. It's not your turn to take care of how our Yang family chooses people."
She was really angry. If the four major families hadn't joined forces to target the Yang family, would the Yang family have fallen to this point?
Every time there is a selection of Shenyan Sect disciples, those who pass the screening in the Yang family will end up very miserable, and few of them can escape unscathed.
If not, no one would dare to come to the Yang family to sign up.
The Yang family also thought about no longer participating in the selection of Shenyan Sect disciples, but they were unwilling to give up.
There is no way. Over the years, not much of the Yang family's resources have been misappropriated. If they don't even participate in the selection of Shenyan Sect disciples, then they really have to be removed.
You know, every time the Shenyan Sect disciples are selected, the five major families will benefit.
The more people who pass, the more outstanding their performance will be, and the greater the benefits will be.
Although Yang Yu was angry, he did not get entangled.
"Let's go."
She left a cold word, pulled Li Xuan and wanted to leave.
There is no other way, I am not as strong as others, so I can only endure it.
Over the years, this was not the first time she had endured such humiliation.
However, Yang Yu failed to pull Li Xuan.
She raised her head and looked at Li Xuan doubtfully, and couldn't help but sigh in her heart.
Could it be that Li Xuan didn't dare to go to the Yang family to sign up?
This is understandable.
After all, this wasn't the first time this happened, she was used to it.
However, just when she was feeling disappointed and planning to leave alone, Li Xuan suddenly asked, "Miss Yang, can we do something here?"
As soon as these words came out, not only Yang Yu was stunned, but even Lin Chuan and the other three were stunned.
They all looked at Li Xuan in disbelief, as if they had heard some big joke.
After coming back to his senses, Yang Yu was shocked and said quickly, "Master, you must not act recklessly. Although Lin Chuan has a bit of a bad mouth, he is not weak in strength."
"His cultivation has reached the first level of the Xiantian realm, and he can be ranked among the top five even in the Lin family. This time he will definitely join the Shenyan Sect. You can't beat him."
Yang Yu pulled Li Xuan to sign up, not because of Li Xuan's talent and strength.
Just kidding, Li Xuan didn't do anything, how could she know Li Xuan's talent and strength?
She just happened to see Li Xuan hit a wall at the Lin family, so she went over to pull him over.
In fact, she just had a thought and didn't have high hopes that Li Xuan could pass the Shenyan Sect disciple selection.
"Oh, you are not convinced and you want to learn from each other?"
At this moment, Lin Chuan's voice came.
He looked at Li Xuan with a look of disdain, "Boy, it seems that you have never been out or been beaten severely."
He looked at Yang Yu again and grinned: "Don't worry, I, Lin Chuan, don't even bother to deal with this kind of thing, and he doesn't deserve it either. These two people behind me are enough."
Li Xuan ignored Lin Chuan. He just looked at Yang Yu, "Can I take action here? What will happen if I hit him?"
Li Xuan didn't care about people like Lin Chuan at all.
Just a clown.
What he really cares about is the Lin family behind Lin Chuan.
After all, he has no backer now. If he beats the younger one and the older one escapes, it will be in trouble.
Yang Yu saw Li Xuan being so determined and whispered: "As long as both parties are willing, they can do it. If he loses, it means he is not as strong as others. The Lin family can't say anything."
She obviously also understood Li Xuan's worries and gave Li Xuan a reassurance, "Don't worry, although our Yang family is weak, there is still no problem in keeping you. It is absolutely impossible for the Lin family to bully the small."
Li Xuan was relieved.
